name: Image + text
description: Story block with checklist and image; flip with "reverse".
constraints: Keep the root <section class="mx mx-…"> and inner <div class="mx-in"> wrappers.
Colours, fonts and radius come from theme CSS variables — do not hard-code colours.
Keep data-reveal attributes; motion is disabled automatically for reduced-motion users.
Use inline SVG/gradient art or uploaded images only — no external image hosts.

spec.title: Small team, big ambitions
paragraphs: We started with a simple idea: great work should feel effortless for the people who receive it.
Today we partner with organisations of every size to make that idea real.
